book.biginventory.big_inventory.name: Big Inventory Book
book.biginventory.big_inventory.landing: Use your hotbar for what you need now and your backpack for everything else. Start with $(l:biginventory:inventory/controls)storage controls$(/l), or see how $(l:biginventory:weight/capacity)weight and capacity$(/l) work.
biginventory.tooltip.endant: Half weight beyond the first stack of each stored item
biginventory.tip.bag_exhaustion: A Bag adds 352 capacity and 15% movement exhaustion. With three Bags, sprinting, jumping, and swimming cost 45% more. Pack lunch.
biginventory.tip.carry_capacity: The backpack starts at 500 capacity by default. Items in your nine hotbar slots don't count toward it.
biginventory.tip.chest_transfer: Shift-click a backpack slot with a chest open to move up to one regular stack. The rest stays in the backpack.
biginventory.tip.cobblestone_reserve: The number to the right of the hotbar includes matching blocks in both your hotbar and backpack. Check it before starting the bridge.
biginventory.tip.disc_collection: Identical music discs can share a backpack slot. Four copies of Cat still only get you one song.
biginventory.tip.echo_ring: Two Echo Rings double your capacity after Pouches and Bags are counted.
biginventory.tip.end_city: End City treasure chests can contain an Endant. Check the chest even if you came for the elytra.
biginventory.tip.endant_weight: With an Endant and the default weight rules, 128 cobblestone weigh 96. The first 64 count in full, and the rest count half.
biginventory.tip.exact_stack_count: A backpack stack labeled 1k may contain more than 1,000 items. Hover over it for the exact count.
biginventory.tip.first_empty_slot: Shift-clicking from a chest fills matching stacks first, then empty slots in the hotbar, then empty slots in the backpack.
biginventory.tip.hip_pockets: A Pouch adds 98 capacity in a Hip slot. Dye it with any dye. The color has no effect on how much it holds.
biginventory.tip.hotbar_number: Hover over a backpack slot and press 1–9 to move items to that hotbar slot. Large stacks fill an empty or matching slot up to its regular limit.
biginventory.tip.inventory_book: With Patchouli installed, craft the Big Inventory Book from a book, gray dye, and a chest. The recipe does call for the entire chest.
biginventory.tip.mod_search: Type @Biomes Black in backpack search to find things like Black Sand from Biomes O' Plenty.
biginventory.tip.over_capacity: If removing a Bag leaves you over capacity, your items stay put. Re-equip it or unload into a chest to get back to full speed.
biginventory.tip.red_ring: Crouch to see the backpack's capacity percentage. A red ring means you're overloaded. Taking off another Bag will make this worse.
biginventory.tip.spare_tools: When auto-refill is enabled, a spare tool can take over an empty hotbar slot when the old one breaks.
biginventory.tip.storage_sort: Middle-click a backpack slot with an empty cursor to sort and combine matching stacks, including the rows you can't see.
biginventory.tip.tool_weight: With default settings, one spare pickaxe weighs as much as 32 cobblestone. Check how many 'just in case' pickaxes you packed.
biginventory.tip.warden_odds: A Warden has a 25% chance to drop an Echo Ring. You can also craft one with an echo shard and three gold ingots.
